scope: nonblind fixed extension of the two previously released validation sessions; four final blind files excluded
selection: same start and initial conditions as published 300s protocol; require complete next1800s; no residual-based shortening
models: unchanged B cell and observation freezes; SPMe and DFN mesh40, SPMe mesh80; isothermal initial measured temperature
solver: existing frozen run_model rtol1e-7 atol1e-8, 240-second wall limit per solve; missing/timeout INCONCLUSIVE, completed failed criteria FAIL
fit: none; no parameter or initialization retuning
secondary: errors over0-300,300-900,900-1800 seconds; measured cell4 temperature range; no thermal prediction claim
A_comparison: unmodified parameter values, homogeneous isothermal 1RC law; ages0 and0.15; initialize by own OCV inversion of prebaseline BMS voltage; left-held current; no SOC clamp, out-of-domain marked; same fixed observation adapter; NOT full vehicle backend replay
decision: PASS_LIMITED only if four primary cases and both mesh comparisons pass, otherwise FAIL for valid completed failing cases or INCONCLUSIVE for missing cases; never supersedes narrower300s verdict
independence: sessions already exposed, extension is not new blind validation; one module, no population confidence intervals
